content_zh:
“有人出一千万，让我给顾青山下药，怂恿他对苏雪儿表白。”
老者轻声吟道：“那个人是谁？”
张野道：“对方用的是网络匿名账户，我也不知道是谁。”
这就是真相了。
可惜的是，线索到这里就彻底断掉。
老者的表情凝重起来。
做这件事的人很小心，很警惕。
这个人胆敢从苏家大小姐的朋友入手，旁敲侧击的对付苏家大小姐，还做的这么毫无纰漏，这件事就不简单了。
毕竟，这里可是长宁郡，是苏家的地盘。
老者收回自己的手，张野立刻清醒了过来。
他扑通一声跪在地上，痛哭流涕道：“是我鬼迷心窍，青山，我对不起你。”
顾青山望着他。
张野跪在地上慢慢朝顾青山挪动，哀求道：“青山，你我多年的好友，这次是我错了，求求你，原谅我吧。”
他也是个聪明人，知道自己表面上暗害的只是顾青山，便马上朝顾青山求情。
顾青山这个人，平日里总是与人为善，又是他张野的至交，自己当着这么多人的面，不顾脸皮的求饶，恐怕顾青山也不好太过逼迫。
苏雪儿更是个容易心软的，只要顾青山原谅了自己，估计苏雪儿也不会再追究。
这件事并没有造成什么严重后果，只要苏雪儿不追究，那么苏家也不会拿他一个穷学生死命折腾。
果然，苏雪儿望向顾青山，迟疑道：“你看怎么办，他……毕竟也是同学。”
苏姨马上插话道：“小姐，这件事没那么简单，必须追查到底。”
她用严厉的目光扫了扫顾青山。

顾青山什么也没说。
他只是抬起脚，狠狠踹在张野的胸口。
张野被踹飞出去数米远，如滚地葫芦一般撞翻了两张酒桌，被满桌酒食淋了一身。
他昏死过去。
顾青山道：“苏姨，后面拜托你们了，务必挖出他背后的人。”
苏姨打量着他道：“放心。”
她手一挥，一辆灵巧的飞梭从天而降。
这艘钢铁飞梭上有着特殊的纹路，代表了来自九府苏氏的尊贵身份。
老者拖着张野上了飞梭。
苏姨道：“小姐，今天不宜再久留了，我们也先回去。”
苏雪儿点点头，临走时望向顾青山，淡淡说道：“明天晚上，我去你的摊子上吃烧烤。”
这是表示愿意赴约。
顾青山怔了怔，道：“好。”
这正是刚才他告白时，临时所提的荒唐请求，没成想苏雪儿居然来真的。
不过顾青山倒也没什么担心的，他每天放学后，确实都会去摆摊做烧烤，用赚来的钱维持生计。
苏雪儿冲他微微点头，随着苏姨走向苏家的飞梭。
飞梭很快离去。
苏家一走，许多势力的代表也跟着走了，一场盛大的毕业晚会就此草草收场。
这大概是长宁贵族私立高中历史上，最失败的一次毕业晚会。
不过这对顾青山来说，这却是人生中最好的晚会。

他终于避免了那种百口莫辩的悲惨情况，没有像上一世那样，被学校赶出去。
数日后，他将有资格参加联邦统一举行的高考。
以他的成绩，完全可以凭借这一次高考，选择上一所心仪的大学。
等到末日来临，一些大学将成为人类玩家的集中地。
许多高手都从这里走出去。
另外，张野的下场恐怕就不太妙了。
苏雪儿与张野的关系并没有那么好，再加上此事乃是张野在背后操纵，一下子针对了顾青山和苏雪儿两个人。
不但苏雪儿不会为了张野求情，接下来，苏家也会为了找出张野背后的人物，好好审问张野。
前世自己的遭遇，将会以更惨烈的方式降临在张野身上。
这一世，一切都改变了。
顾青山心情愉悦的迈开脚步，往学校外走去。
他是贫民窟的孤儿，买不起飞梭，坐不起出租车，每天上下学都只能依靠自己的双腿。
半个小时后。
顾青山走出繁华地段，快要到达贫民街区的时候，忽然停住了脚步。
前方的巷子口，一艘九米长的流线形飞梭静静的停在那里。
一名身穿白衬衣，打着黑色领结的中年人站在飞梭旁边，冲着顾青山礼貌的鞠了一躬。
“顾同学，我家少爷在飞梭中等你。”中年人说道。
顾青山默默看了眼街角上的安全监控器，原本闪烁着红光的视频监控信号早已熄灭。
就连这片街区的四周，也没有一个人走进来。
“你家少爷是谁？”顾青山问道。

content_en:
"Someone offered me 10 million to drug Gu Qingshan and encourage him to confess to Amelia Su."
The old man groaned softly: "Who is that person?"
Zhang Yedao: "The other party is using an anonymous online account, and I don't know who it is."
This is the truth.
Unfortunately, the clues are completely cut off here.
The old man's expression became serious.
The people who do this are very careful and vigilant.
This person dared to start from the friends of the eldest daughter of the Su family, and deal with the eldest daughter of the Su family in a subtle way, and he did it so flawlessly. This matter is not simple.
After all, this is Changning County, the territory of the Su family.
The old man took back his hand, and Zhang Ye woke up immediately.
He knelt on the ground with a plop and cried bitterly: "It's me who is obsessed with it, Qingshan, I'm sorry for you."
Gu Qingshan looked at him.
Zhang Ye knelt on the ground and slowly moved towards Gu Qingshan, pleading: "Qingshan, you and I have been friends for many years. I was wrong this time. Please forgive me."
He was also a smart man, knowing that he was only harming Gu Qingshan on the surface, so he immediately interceded with Gu Qingshan.
Gu Qingshan is always kind to others, and he is Zhang Ye's best friend. He begged for mercy in front of so many people without caring about his face. I'm afraid Gu Qingshan can't force him too much.
Su Xueer is even more prone to softening of heart. As long as Gu Qingshan forgives her, Su Xueer probably won't pursue the case again.
This incident did not cause any serious consequences. As long as Su Xueer did not pursue it, the Su family would not torture a poor student like him to death.
Sure enough, Su Xueer looked at Gu Qingshan and said hesitantly: "What do you think? He... is also a classmate after all."
Aunt Su immediately interjected: "Miss, this matter is not that simple. We must get to the bottom of it."
She glanced at Gu Qingshan with a stern look.
Gu Qingshan said nothing.
He just raised his foot and kicked Zhang Ye hard on the chest.
Zhang Ye was kicked several meters away, knocking over two wine tables like a gourd rolling on the ground, and was covered with wine and food all over the table.
He passed out.
Gu Qingshan said: "Aunt Su, I'll leave it to you later. Be sure to dig out the person behind him."
Aunt Su looked at him and said, "Don't worry."
She waved her hand, and a dexterous shuttle fell from the sky.
There are special patterns on this steel shuttle, which represents the noble status of the Su family from Jiufu.
The old man dragged Zhang Ye onto the shuttle.
Aunt Su said: "Miss, it's not appropriate to stay any longer today. Let's go back first."
Su Xueer nodded, looked at Gu Qingshan before leaving, and said lightly: "Tomorrow night, I will go to your stall to have barbecue."
This is an expression of willingness to keep the appointment.
Gu Qingshan was stunned and said: "Okay."
This was exactly the ridiculous request he made on the spur of the moment when he confessed just now, but he didn't expect that Su Xueer actually meant it.
But Gu Qingshan has nothing to worry about. He does set up a stall and cook barbecue every day after school, and uses the money he earns to make ends meet.
Amelia Su nodded slightly at him and followed Aunt Su's shuttle towards the Su family.
The shuttle quickly left.
As soon as the Su family left, representatives of many forces also left, and a grand graduation party ended hastily.
This was probably the most failed graduation party in the history of Changning Noble Private High School.
But for Gu Qingshan, this is the best party in his life.
He finally avoided the tragic situation of being unable to explain anything, and was not kicked out of school like in his previous life.
In a few days, he will be eligible to take the federal college entrance examination.
With his grades, he can definitely rely on this college entrance examination to choose a university of his choice.
When the end comes, some universities will become centers for human players.
Many masters have come out from here.
In addition, Zhang Ye's end may not be good.
The relationship between Su Xueer and Zhang Ye is not that good. In addition, Zhang Ye was behind this matter, and suddenly targeted Gu Qingshan and Su.Xue'er two people.
Not only will Su Xueer not plead for Zhang Ye, but the Su family will also interrogate Zhang Ye in order to find out the person behind Zhang Ye.
What happened to him in his previous life will befall Zhang Ye in a more tragic way.
In this life, everything has changed.
Gu Qingshan stepped forward happily and walked outside the school.
He is an orphan in the slums. He cannot afford a shuttle or take a taxi. He can only rely on his own legs to go to and from school every day.
Half an hour later.
Gu Qingshan walked out of the bustling area and when he was about to reach the poor neighborhood, he suddenly stopped.
At the entrance of the alley in front, a nine-meter-long streamlined shuttle was quietly parked there.
A middle-aged man wearing a white shirt and black tie stood next to the shuttle and bowed politely to Gu Qingshan.
"Classmate Gu, my young master is waiting for you in the shuttle," the middle-aged man said.
Gu Qingshan silently glanced at the security monitor on the street corner. The originally flashing red video surveillance signal had long been extinguished.
Even around this block, no one came in.
"Who is your young master?" Gu Qingshan asked.
